cues: There is very blank sugar left, so make the tea without it.
Sugar is uncountable, and the amount is almost none: little.
Blank students attended, because there was a strike: plural countable, almost none: few.
He has blank friends there, so he is never lonely: plural countable, and positive: a few.
Remember: few and little are negative, meaning hardly any; a few and a little are positive, meaning some.
